verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs say marketers can set up workflows that automate actions after an email is sent, and the product page refers to nurture emails, so first-party automation exists. The evidence only describes these as "simple" workflows and never shows multi-step lifecycle journeys. missing for 10: documented branching logic, delay steps, exit or unenrollment rules, welcome/onboarding/winback series templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: You can set up simple workflows to automate actions after the email is sent.
Rewrite every nurture email for the specific contact receiving it, using their CRM data, behavior, and live company research.
